description: KeplerCam was a 4096x4096 pixel CCD camera with a Fairchild CCD 486 detector on the 1.2-meter telescope at FLWO, used for optical photometry in Harris BVRI, SDSS ugriz, and narrowband filters.
facility_description: The Fred Lawrence Whipple Observatory (FLWO) is an observatory facility on Mount Hopkins, Arizona, operated by the Center for Astrophysics | Harvard & Smithsonian.
notes: KeplerCam operated at the Cassegrain focus of the FLWO 1.2m telescope. Filters included 4-inch Harris BVRI sets, SDSS (Sloan) ugriz sets, and narrowbands. Terms follow CfA / Smithsonian Open Access public domain policy.
